allowedHirFamilies.reason: The current experiment is limited to minimal compute modules, compute stages, and entry points admitted by fixture inventory.
Only scalar local type facts, scalar literal facts, and the float pointer storage-buffer element type from admitted compute fixtures are recorded.

Only local scalar arithmetic, constructor casts, comparison expression facts, storage-buffer read/write expressions, unary negation, sampled texture LOD, and direct storage-image load/store calls from admitted compute fixtures are recorded.

Compute local size, set/binding descriptors, storage buffers, sampled texture/sampler facts, and direct storage-image resource facts from admitted fixtures are recorded; this does not enable production MLIR resource lowering.

Only the existing IfComputeShader fixture's structured if/else branch, branch-condition expression, branch-local assignments, and return statement are admitted; loops, break, continue, discard, and early-return control transfer remain outside this experiment.

Only direct compute storage-image descriptors with read_write access, 2D/2D-array dimensions, default rgba32 formats, and imageLoad/imageStore source facts are recorded as report-only catalog evidence.

unsupportedHirFamilies.reason: Direct sampled texture plus sampler LOD facts and direct read_write storage-image load/store facts are admitted; descriptor arrays, nonuniform texture or image indexing, compare helpers, access-qualified storage images, image atomics, and manual texture intrinsics remain blocked.
Descriptor arrays, dynamic indexing, and nonuniform metadata are unsupported by the MLIR experiment.
CrossTL examples and backend unsupported-policy fixtures are outside the fixture-limited MLIR experiment.

sourceLocations.description: The source file path must stay attached to every admitted MLIR experiment input.
Shader module, compute stage, and entry point locations must be recoverable before broadening the fixture set.
Statement-level provenance is required before comparing real MLIR output with production HIR diagnostics.
The scalar-expression fixture must name local variable declaration, expression statement, and return statement provenance.
The storage-buffer fixture must name local size layout, buffer declaration, storage-buffer write, and return statement provenance.
The structured-if fixture must name the if statement, branch assignment statements, storage-buffer read/write statements, and return statement provenance.

types.description: Admitted fixtures must name entry-point type facts that bound the experiment to compute entry functions.
The scalar-expression fixture must name scalar, literal, cast, arithmetic, and comparison result type facts.
The storage-buffer fixture must name the float pointer buffer type, element type, scalar local type, and assignment expression result facts.
The structured-if fixture must name branch-condition bool facts, branch assignment result facts, unary negation result facts, and reused storage-buffer scalar type facts.

resources.description: The sampled texture fixture preserves the textureLod source fact that combines a texture resource, sampler resource, coordinates, and explicit LOD.
The storage-image fixture preserves direct storage-image descriptor, format, dimension, read_write access, imageLoad, and imageStore facts without admitting descriptor arrays or atomics.
The current fixture records compute local size 1,1,1 as the only resource-adjacent execution fact.
The scalar-expression fixture must remain resource-free while still recording local size 1,1,1.
The StorageBufferComputeShader fixture records the compute-stage storage buffer descriptor at set 0 binding 0.
Storage-buffer-only fixtures must continue to record empty texture, sampler, and storage-image collections while direct storage-image facts are admitted only for the storage-image fixture.
The structured-if fixture reuses the existing set 0 binding 0 float storage buffer fact and adds no new resource families.
Each admitted fixture must name resource parity fields, including explicit empty texture, sampler, image, descriptor, and storage-buffer families when absent.

targetIndependentResourceMetadata.description: The sampled texture fixture target-independent metadata must match descriptor names, stage, set, binding, source type, element type, address space, and access mode for storage buffer, sampled texture, and sampler resources.
Resource metadata records must exclude backend register, argument index, descriptor type, binding class, and emitted target type fields.
Resource-free fixtures must still name an explicit empty targetIndependentResourceMetadata list so absence of resources is audited.
The storage-buffer fixture target-independent metadata must match the HIR descriptor name, stage, set, binding, source type, element type, address space, and access mode.
The structured-if fixture must reuse the same target-independent storage-buffer metadata as its descriptor and storage-buffer facts.

The storage-image fixture target-independent metadata must match descriptor names, stage, set, binding, source type, element type, address space, and read_write access for direct storage-image resources.

diagnosticsProvenance.description: Each admitted fixture must tie diagnostics to the source file, shader module, compute stage, entry point name, and void entry-point type fact.
Each admitted fixture must preserve the recorded local-size triple together with the layout_local_size source-location fact from the fixture source.

Each admitted fixture report must cite the unsupported HIR family ids and reasons that keep texture, image, sampler, descriptor-indexing, nonuniform, CrossTL example, and backend-policy cases outside the optional MLIR experiment.

sourceMapDebugPreservation.description: Every admitted fixture must name the debug metadata and HIR source-map package artifacts that must remain a coherent pair before real MLIR output can graduate.
Every admitted fixture must require debug-metadata schema v11 and HIR source-map schema v7 preservation as report-only evidence.
Every admitted fixture must tie the debug metadata hirSourceLocations and HIR source-map hirSourceLocations to the fixture source-location and type facts.
Every admitted fixture must require unfiltered, unpaged HIR source-map evidence with combined records disabled for package parity comparison.

unavailableEvidence.skipWhenMlirMissing: CROSSGL_ENABLE_MLIR_EXPERIMENTAL=ON; MLIR_FOUND=FALSE; target crossgl_mlir_experiment not created
